name: lacuna-music
description: Generate original music with the Lacuna MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Generate AI music from prompts or lyrics
interface.longDescription: Generate original instrumentals or vocal songs from natural-language style directions and lyrics through Lacuna's MCP server. Submit a task, wait for its result, and receive hosted audio URLs in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Create a mellow instrumental lo-fi track for a late-night coding session.
Turn these lyrics into an upbeat indie-pop song with a female lead vocal.
Check whether my Lacuna music generation is ready and return its audio links.
